subject: Proposal: 30-day trial blueprint and acceptance criteria for Brightline Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Eleni Park <eleni@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: 30-day trial blueprint and acceptance criteria for Brightline Health

Hi Eleni —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our demo, attached is a concise 30-day trial blueprint that maps features to measurable success criteria so Brightline can validate value quickly. High-level summary below (attachment: redwood-30day-blueprint.pdf):

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization + coding assistance across two pilot clinics.
- Success criteria (pass/fail):
  • Accuracy: average ROUGE-L >= 0.55 on the validation set you shared (100 de-identified notes)
  • Latency: median response time <= 450ms for 512-token requests under pilot load
  • Cost: estimated token spend <= $2,500 for the 30-day window with recommended batching settings
  • Reliability: <1% error rate and automated fallback to smaller model for spikes
- Scope: 2 clinics, up to 10 concurrent users, integration via API/webhook for EHR export flow
- Timeline: Kickoff (week 0) → Model & prompt tuning (week 1) → Integration + smoke tests (week 2) → Pilot run (weeks 3–4) → Wrap review (end of week 4)
- Ownership: Marissa (account lead), Rishi (solutions architect), Priyom (deployment & CS/ops).

Ask: can you confirm the validation set size and whether procurement needs a standard MSA or PO for the trial? If you’re good with the criteria above, I can push the trial agreement and schedule a technical kickoff for the week of Oct 5.

I also included a short note on security & data handling in the PDF. We can provide SOC 2 evidence and a scoped data handling attestation before the pilot starts.

Next steps I propose:
- You: confirm acceptance criteria + point of contact for SSO/network (by EOD Wed)
- Us: send trial agreement + SOC2 evidence, estimate of token spend, and optional trial credits (by Thu)
- Schedule: 30–45 minute technical kickoff — suggested: Tue, Oct 5, 10:00 AM PT

Attachments: redwood-30day-blueprint.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Note: Attachment stub — redwood-30day-blueprint.pdf (5 pages, outline: objectives, acceptance criteria, runbook, minimal infra requirements)

From: Eleni Park <eleni@brightlinehealth.com>

Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: 30-day trial blueprint and acceptance criteria for Brightline Health

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap and the PDF. Quick answers and a couple clarifying questions:

- Validation set: we can confirm 120 de-identified outpatient notes (we'll deliver a CSV this week).
- Acceptance criteria: the ROUGE-L target looks reasonable, and latency target aligns with expectations. Can you confirm how you calculate ROUGE (tokenization)? We use SacreROUGE.
- SOC2: procurement will need SOC 2 Type II evidence + a short attestation for our security team. Can you share the report or secure link?
- Cost: $2,500 sounds within budget — can you provide a 2-line cost estimate (trial cap + any overage rate)?
- Kickoff: Oct 5 works for our technical lead (Amit Shah). He prefers mornings PT.

We also need a short clause in the trial agreement stating no PHI will be transmitted and that Brightline will only provide de-identified notes. Procurement will review the draft and revert.

If you can send the SOC2 link and a simple cost table, we can confirm next steps by Wednesday.

Thanks,
Eleni Park
Head of Clinical AI Programs | Brightline Health
eleni@brightlinehealth.com
Phone: +1 (617) 555-0987
